name: Adblock for LoL
creator: moga
description:
###

*MOST * individual elements are modular, i.e. you can re-enable anything you don’t want. The "not-most" can be harder to do yourself. I have a guide on how to unpack the mod, and you’re welcome to ask me which files correspond to specific elements to tweak yours.

**- REMOVED ITEMS**

- New Quest Popup Notification.
- Objective vote popup.
- All "X-Champion Has Slain Y-Objective" or "X-Champion Pentakill" announcement banners. (The text isn't is now removed., only icons and stylized borders are gone.)
- New Spectate Death Recap and the old DR Showcase "Press 'n' to hide" (if they ever bring that garbage back).
- "You can't buy items once you leave fountain" ARAM/SR sidebar popup.
- On-death health bar crumble animations.
- Spell Shield and Invulnerable animated SHEEN. (The purple/gold health bar border is still there, this is just the overlayed sheen ([fancy "shine" glow swipe](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jxr4YK_m8hc)) animation.)
- All tutorial arrows.
- Suggested spell Level-Up sheen and arrow.
- Level-Up clicked and idle animations (omega cringe)
- Anything labeled voice chat.
- Item shop minimap icon. (A little dot that indicates where the shopkeeper is.)
- Camera lock, settings, jungle, voice chat, and clickable pings minimap buttons.
- Special quest popups (Morgana vs. Aatrox)
- Any and hopefully all random and needless  highlights or sheen effects designed to grab your attention.
- New unleashed spellbook animation bullshit
